import importlib.util, hashlib, json, sys
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(root/"src"), str(root/"shared/runtime")]
def load(path, name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[name]=module; spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module
current_path=root/"generators/9df67b512dad/generator.py"
baseline_path=root.parent/".review/baseline/repo/generators/9df67b512dad/generator.py"
current=load(current_path,"current_canonical")
baseline=load(baseline_path,"baseline_canonical")
def pair(multicolor):
    grid=[[2,0,2,0,7,0,2],[2,0,0,0,0,0,2],[0,0,0,0,0,0,0],[7,0,2,0,7,0,7],[2,0,2,0,7,0,0]]
    label=[[2,7,2],[7,7,7],[2,7,0]]
    if not multicolor:
        grid=[[2 if v==7 else v for v in row] for row in grid]
        label=[[2 if v==7 else v for v in row] for row in label]
    assert current.self_check(grid)==[]
    return {"input":grid,"output":label}
results=[]
for demo_multi in (False,True):
    for query_multi in (False,True):
        demos=[pair(demo_multi) for _ in range(4)]
        query=pair(query_multi)
        reasons=current.lesson_identifiable(demos,query)
        expected_reject=(not demo_multi and query_multi)
        assert bool(reasons)==expected_reject,(demo_multi,query_multi,reasons)
        results.append({"demo_multicolor":demo_multi,"query_multicolor":query_multi,"expected_reject":expected_reject,"reasons":reasons})
demos=[pair(True) for _ in range(4)]; query=pair(True)
query["output"][1][1]=9
assert current.lesson_identifiable(demos,query)
results.append({"case":"tampered_query_label","status":"rejected"})
# Probe Python numeric equality at the label boundary; compare old and current.
demos=[pair(True) for _ in range(4)]; query=pair(True)
for p in demos+[query]: p["output"]=[[float(v) for v in row] for row in p["output"]]
current_reasons=current.lesson_identifiable(demos,query)
baseline_reasons=baseline.lesson_identifiable(demos,query)
numeric={"case":"float_labels","current_reasons":current_reasons,"baseline_reasons":baseline_reasons,"baseline_label_validation_rejects":any("output does not match" in x for x in baseline_reasons)}
out=root.parent/"checks/adversarial"; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
report={"schema":"bounded-independent-review-v1","task_id":"9df67b512dad","canonical_sha256":hashlib.sha256(current_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"baseline_sha256":hashlib.sha256(baseline_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"canonical_probes":results,"numeric_observation":numeric,"limits":["Hand-derived fixture cases only; not a full corpus or seed sweep.","Float-label acceptance is pre-existing Python equality behavior, outside the scoped semantic-hook repair."]}

from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, sys, os, json, copy, hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); sys.path[:0]=[str(root/"src"),str(root/"shared/runtime")]
os.environ["RACKET_PATH"]=str(root.parent/".review/racket-runtime/racket/bin/racket")
path=root/"generators/9df67b512dad/workspace/parametric/prototype.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("independent_zone_prototype",path)
p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=p; spec.loader.exec_module(p)
out=root.parent/"checks/adversarial"; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
results=[]
with p.RacketOracle() as oracle:
    episode=p.generate_episode(4381,demos=1,queries=1,oracle=oracle)
    for mutation in ("missing_seed","null_settings","float_query_output"):
        case=copy.deepcopy(episode)
        if mutation=="missing_seed": del case["_private"]["seed"]
        elif mutation=="null_settings": case["_private"]["settings"]=None
        else: case["test"][0]["output"]=[[float(v) for v in row] for row in case["test"][0]["output"]]
        dest=out/mutation
        try:
            response=p.write_export([case],dest,oracle=oracle)
            outcome={"result":"accepted","response":response}
        except Exception as exc:
            outcome={"result":"rejected","exception":type(exc).__name__,"message":str(exc)}
        results.append({"mutation":mutation,**outcome,"destination_created":dest.exists(),"files_created":[str(x.relative_to(dest)) for x in dest.rglob("*") if x.is_file()] if dest.exists() else []})
    forged=copy.deepcopy(episode)
    forged["_private"]["demonstration_certificate"]={"survivors":[],"forged":True}
    altered=copy.deepcopy(forged); altered["_private"]["seed"]=999
    altered["test"][0]["output"]=[[0]]
    assert p.public_challenge_bytes(episode)==p.public_challenge_bytes(altered)
    response=p.write_export([forged],out/"forged_certificate",oracle=oracle)
    public_id=p.public_challenge_id(forged)
    saved=json.loads((out/"forged_certificate/private/episodes"/(public_id+".json")).read_text())
    assert saved["_private"]["demonstration_certificate"]==episode["_private"]["demonstration_certificate"]
    results.append({"mutation":"forged_certificate","result":"recomputed_and_replaced","public_identity_invariant_to_private_metadata_and_query_answers":True})
report={"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"runtime":oracle.runtime_identity,"cases":results}
(out/"prototype-probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, sys, os, json, copy, hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); sys.path[:0]=[str(root/"src"),str(root/"shared/runtime")]
os.environ["RACKET_PATH"]=str(root.parent/".review/racket-runtime/racket/bin/racket")
path=root/"generators/9df67b512dad/workspace/parametric/prototype.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("independent_zone_recheck",path)
p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name]=p; spec.loader.exec_module(p)
out=root.parent/"checks/adversarial"
cases=[]
with p.RacketOracle() as oracle:
    episode=p.generate_episode(4381,demos=1,queries=1,oracle=oracle)
    for name in ("missing_seed","null_settings","missing_input_seed"):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(episode)
        if name=="null_settings": changed["_private"]["settings"]=None
        elif name=="missing_seed": del changed["_private"]["seed"]
        else: del changed["_private"]["input_seed"]
        dest=out/("recheck_"+name)
        try:
            p.write_export([changed],dest,oracle=oracle)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert not dest.exists(),name
            cases.append({"name":name,"status":"rejected_before_destination","exception":str(exc)})
        else:
            raise AssertionError(name+" was accepted")
report=json.loads((out/"review.json").read_text())
recheck={"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"cases":cases,"exit_code":0}
(out/"prototype-recheck.json").write_text(json.dumps(recheck,indent=2)+"\n")
report["prototype_final_reviewed_sha256"]=recheck["source_sha256"]
for finding in report["findings"]:
    if finding["id"] in ("export_missing_seed_partial_write","export_null_settings"):
        finding["status"]="fixed_and_independently_verified"
        finding["verification"]="prototype-recheck.json"
report["limits"]=[x for x in report["limits"] if "await" not in x]
report["limits"].append("Final recheck is limited to reported provenance fixes; initial passing surfaces were inspected on the immediately preceding source.")
report["command_statuses"].append({"name":"prototype_provenance_fix_recheck","exit_code":0,"evidence":"prototype-recheck.json"})
(out/"review.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(recheck,indent=2))
